run_publisher_loop: run the alice.py script that continuously publishes incrementing messages to some/topic every second
review_publisher_usage: review how a0.Publisher is instantiated with a topic string and used to publish messages
summarize_pub_method: summarize the pub method usage that sends string messages to a Publisher on a given topic
refactor_publisher_interval: refactor the alice.py publisher loop to adjust the time.sleep interval between messages
test_publisher_topic: test the a0.Publisher by running alice.py and verifying messages are published to some/topic
